title: Book Three · Chapter 98: Nine Books on the Shelf
story:
The woman at the table chooses two puzzle books.

Both are B books from the first bought pile. She pays four yuan. Leo writes them down, and Ronan puts the money away.

At nine thirty-five, Kai comes back from the library.

“Anna went with the group,” he tells Ronan. “At a quarter past. She got your note.”

Ronan looks at his visit bag under the chair.

“Did she say anything?”

“She asked what happened. I didn't know.”

Leo moves nearer.

“You can still go across town,” he says.

Ronan looks at the people near the price card. Someone is pointing to the games book.

“I'll find her when the group comes back.”

Kai says goodbye and leaves. He has his own morning with his friend.

The games book goes next. It is Ronan's last R book. A boy's older brother pays two yuan for it.

Then Mrs Deng comes from the fruit shop. She opens Leo's garden book and finds a picture of a plant her brother likes.

“For him,” she says.

She pays two yuan and puts the book in her basket.

Near eleven, another customer chooses two B storybooks. Those bring four more yuan.

The boys clear the table at the agreed time. Both paid Saturday mornings are finished now. Mr Qiu takes the folding table back.

Inside, Leo counts the remaining stock. Nine books. One L railway book and eight B books.

Ronan checks the public morning's money. Four for puzzles, two for games, two for the garden, four for stories. Twelve yuan.

The envelope held thirty-seven after Mr Wei's order. Now it holds forty-nine.

They started with twenty-five yuan. Customers paid twenty-four yuan this morning. The boys sold twelve books in all.

Ronan writes the totals, but his hand stops near the visit time in the notebook.

Leo looks at the same page.

“I said I could stay here.”

“I know.”

“You stayed too.”

Ronan closes the envelope.

“I thought the first handover would be quick.”

Leo says nothing. He puts the nine books in the two cloth bags and moves them off Mum's part of the table.

Ronan takes his own bag and goes outside. He walks toward the library. At the bread shop, he nearly turns toward home.

Then he keeps going.

The library doors are open. The visit group will return about one. He sits on the low wall near the entrance with his full water bottle beside him.

For the first time that morning, nobody is asking him about a book.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

total＝合计数；remain＝剩下；handover＝交接；clear the table＝收好桌上的东西。

## 理解问题

1. 常规营业时段又卖了几本、收到多少钱？加早单后的现金和库存各是多少？
2. Anna有没有因为等Ronan放弃活动？Leo对Ronan留下这件事怎样说？

## 读句子

**The boys sold twelve books in all.**

拆开看：The boys / sold twelve books / in all.

两个男孩／卖出了十二本书／总共。
